svg.title: The curse of dimensionality
svg.desc: With 10 points per direction, a grid needs 10 points on a line, 100 on a square, 1,000 in a cube, 10 billion in 10 dimensions and 10 to the power 100 in 100 dimensions, more than the roughly 10 to the 80 atoms in the observable universe. A financial problem with 100 stocks has 100 dimensions.
svg.text: 10 points per direction seem few… until directions pile up
Pricing an option on 100 stocks = an equation in 100 dimensions.
Classic grids are impossible; Monte Carlo and neural networks still manage.
